data.name: Agarest: Generations of War
data.detailed_description:
No início dos tempos, a guerra rebenta entre as forças do bem e do mal, terminando na destruição do mundo. Os vitoriosos Deuses de Luz usaram os corpos dos Deuses da Escuridão para criar um novo mundo.

Agora, as forças da escuridão despertaram de novo…

• Combate centenas de criaturas diferentes usando um vasto leque de potencialidades das personagens, num combate inovador por turnos!
• Cria um exército de soldados único. Extra Capacidades Master, Artes Especiais e Matanças Massivas para vencer inimigos colossais!
• Escolhe o caminho da luz ou das trevas. Cria relações e usa o sistema “Soul Breed” para criar a próxima geração de heróis

DLC gratuito incluído

Basic Pack - A basic package. It contains 1 each of Resurrect, Capture, and Resist Direction, 2 each of Heal and Refresh, and 5 Vessels of Life.
Offense-Defense Pack- Contains 1 Adaka, 1 Shield Sword, 1 Bird Eye, 1 Magic Frame, 1 Critical Hit, and 2 Seeds of Happiness.
Additional-Points Pack 1 - Contains 10,000G, 100PP, 250TP, and 500EP.
Recovery-Skill Pack - Contains 2 Light Heals, 2 Harvest Heals, and 2 Cure Alls, as well as 1 Prayer, 1 Gospel, and 1 Counter.
Flower Pack - Contains 1 Lucky Charm, 1 HP Up, 1 Resist Ailments, 1 Restore HP 15%, and 1 Restore AP++, as well as 2 Moonlight Flowers, and 3 Tree Spirit Souls.
General-Purpose Pack - Contains 1 Magic Blade, 1 Partisan, 1 Battle Frame, 1 Bracelet of Feicui, and 1 Item Drop Rate Up, as well as 2 Shiny Fangs, and 2 Advanced Heals.
Add-on Dungeon 1 - An add-on dungeon for generation 1. An uncharted adventure awaits you on the Holy Island of Erin!
Add-on Dungeon 2 - An add-on dungeon for generation 2. A new frontier waits to be explored along the Trum Coast!
Add-on Dungeon 3 - An add-on dungeon for generation 3. It's time to reunite with old friends at Magna Val!
Add-on Dungeon 4 - An add-on dungeon for generation 4. Embark on an exciting journey to the mysterious Tresor Island!
Add-on Dungeon 5 - An add-on dungeon for generation 5. Embark on one last adventure into the Deep Forest Naruvia!
Amateur-Breeder Pack - Contains 2 Mithril Beast Claws, 2 Large Mithril Claws+, 2 Big Beast Fangs+, and 2 Stardust Fangs+. This is the week to adore your dog.
Top-Breeder Pack - Contains 2 Stardust Claws, 2 Mithril Beast Claws+, 2 Beast King Fangs+, and 2 Stardust Claws+. Your monster will look nice and pretty with this wonderful new items!
The Role-model Pack - Contains 1 Langguth Sword, 1 S.O.C., and 1 Extra Frame. "Langguth Sword. A holy sword that shines with the sacred light of god." Wow, it couldn't be more perfect!
Ceremony Pack - Contains 1 Alfa Beld Spear, 1 Gate of Hell, and 1 Chaos Frame. These seem like something you use to open a portal to the netherworld, don't they? Be careful...
Elegant-Holiday Pack - Contains 1 Washer, 1 Man's Fist, and 1 Halper Scythe. Wash your dog with the Washer, equip yourself with the Man's Fist, and throw the Halper Scythe. Go fetch! This will add a little spice to your weekend--uh, no. Scythes aren't meant for throwing. That would be really dangerous. Seriously.

reviews.review:
The grind on this one is unholy. Even with all the DLC...it's still an absolute slog.

Combat is repetitive. For every five minutes of story progress you have to push through two or three identical battles. On later playthroughs I was grateful for the auto-battle, but if you're not overpowered it's pretty risky to use since the AI will throw everything at a single enemy and you'll usually end up with some party members knocked out. There's aspects of the combat system I like -- putting together combos, equipping my party with skills that mesh together, etc -- but the sheer amount of repetition, especially in order to level up or farm, makes it unfun. I had to use the wiki frequently for a lot of the crafting, and farming items from lower level monsters is tedious since you barely get any XP or money for it. The crafting system has this...quirk...where crafts can fail and you end up losing all the resources you put in which is a major pain.

I didn't find the story engaging enough to make up for the irritating gameplay. You play through the same story over and over on different continents, with a different protagonist, but everything looks the same and someone's been corrupted by evil and you're briefly introduced to three female characters who you barely have time to get attached to in the mind-numbing slog through battle after battle, before it's time to do it all again. Maybe the endings make up for it, but to be honest I made it to Gen 4 before I started skipping dialogue because it just...wasn't worth it.

Besides needing guides for items and crafting, you need one for the True End. I'm currently in the post-game caught up in more grinding to beat all the bosses (and who knows how many more hours to max out the attributes) and honestly I don't think I'm going to touch a JRPG for a good long while after I'm done because this has scarred me.

content_descriptors.notes:
Agarest: Generations of War is a Japanese strategy RPG in the traditional vein. Gameplay is divided between grid-based tactical battles where players take on a variety of enemies and 2D visual-novel-style dialogue sections where the vast majority of the game’s story is developed.
During the dialog sections the player is required to make choices that affect their relationships with various female side-characters. At fixed points in the story the player character will marry the side-character with the highest affinity, affecting who the player character will be in the next ‘generation’ of story.
Throughout the game the player reaches sections of storyline where still 2D images of female characters are depicted in provocative situations. Although there is no nudity, there are some images of veiled nudity and some situations with a sexual innuendo.
